title: Pontotoc gets three mild days before Sunday showers and a cooler Monday
excerpt: Highs near 71 are forecast Thursday through Saturday. Patchy fog may form Saturday night, and Sunday brings a 30% chance of showers.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc has three afternoons near 71 degrees ahead before a cold front brings a chance of showers Sunday. The National Weather Service’s Wednesday afternoon forecast calls for sunshine Thursday, mostly sunny skies Friday and more clouds by Saturday.

Evenings will warm more slowly. The city forecast puts Thursday night’s low near 49 degrees and Friday night’s near 54. For people out late Saturday or on the road early Sunday, forecasters flag patchy fog. The county forecast puts Saturday night’s low in the mid-50s.

The county forecast gives Sunday a 30% chance of showers. By Sunday evening the chance drops to 20%, with a thunderstorm also possible. The Memphis forecast office expects any rain with the front to fall short of what the region needs to break the drought.

Monday marks the bigger change in temperature. The city forecast puts the afternoon high near 59, about 12 degrees below Saturday’s forecast high. Monday night’s low is near 36, followed by a mostly sunny Tuesday with a high near 57.
